items.title: First Hurricane Simon fatality in Mexico identified: Albino Moreno Jimenez, 71
items.summary: Guerrero governor Evelyn Salgado's Monday briefing confirmed the Simon death was 71-year-old Albino Moreno Jimenez, killed when a retaining wall collapsed on him in the western outskirts of Chilpancingo, Guerrero while he was feeding his animals. The detail traces to Guerrero-based news agency IRZA. Simon death toll in Mexico remains 1 (plus 1 Rachel death in Baja California and 1 cliff-diver death in Mazatlan, both previously reported).
